items.claim: Opacity scrub can't raise a selection whose paints are all at alpha 0, though the readout climbs
items.note: This shares a commit with the next finding, because both come down to one scale-factor formula.

items.claim: One wheel notch down makes the dimmer nodes of a mixed selection more opaque
items.note: Every node now scales by the target over the session's brightest alpha.

items.claim: A paint edit made while O is held is reverted by the next wheel turn
Recorded moves drop `pointerId`, so a two-pointer gesture replays as the wrong pointer
A path effect inside a frame (a later page or a rigid group) exports at its frame-local coordinates
items.note: It now places through the same helper `booleanToObj` uses.

items.claim: Copy-as-SVG's viewBox is the geometric box, so strokes and markers are cut off and skipped roots take room
items.note: The selection is now fitted with `svgBoundsOf`, which `@weasel-js/svg` now exports. That export has a `minor` `api` changeset.

items.claim: SVG import can mint an `svg-N` id that the file already carries, giving two drafts one id
A replay outlives a detached canvas and can't be stopped
items.note: Question: pressing Play during a replay now stops it, and the action shows as active while a replay runs. That was my call; it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under round thirty-four.

items.claim: A recording that fails to save is dropped silently, with an unhandled rejection
The recorder throttled moves on one shared clock, so in a two-finger gesture one pointer's moves could starve the other's
Replay set `isPrimary: true` on every pointer
